_comment: issue #1693 — source-recorded byte baseline for the create-issue quality-guidance routing split. AC9: every byte this routing is responsible for across every touched surface — the reference surface (issue-template.md + the six quality groups, whole; issue #1692 added the compatibility-and-rollout group, which fits inside the headroom the #1693 split created) PLUS the SKILL.md router delta (current SKILL bytes minus router_host_baseline_bytes; SKILL's untouched pre-existing body, into which the routing only added a one-bullet pointer, is not double-counted) — does not exceed this baseline.
